purpose: Decision-support list. Nothing here is implemented without an owner choosing a path. Decision statuses: pending review (default), accepted, declined, deferred.

suggestions.title: Adopt a publication voice and brand system (masthead, byline, section labels)
suggestions.problem: The site currently reads like a generated audit. A consistent editorial voice and brand shell make it read like a shop/publication.

options.A: Full style guide: voice rules, heading patterns, bylines, seasonal tags.
options.B: Lightweight voice template applied to every page (recommended to start).
options.C: No voice work; keep template copy.

suggestions.title: Publish human-sounding, question-shaped buyer guides on a fixed cadence
suggestions.problem: No guides exist yet, so there is nothing organic to rank and no reason for a buyer to return.

options.A: Weekly cadence with 4 launch guides (the working editorial hypotheses).
options.B: Biweekly cadence, 2 launch guides (recommended to start).
options.C: Publish only when data suggests a topic.

suggestions.gate: Each guide must pass the compliance gate (disclosure, sponsored markup) before publishing.

suggestions.title: Build a comparison hub per category (air fryers, thermometers)
suggestions.problem: Buyers comparing options currently have to jump to Amazon; comparison pages capture that intent and feed the shop feel.

options.A: Comparison pages for every category, updated on a schedule.
options.B: Two launch comparisons: dual-basket vs single-basket air fryers; smart vs instant-read thermometers (recommended).

suggestions.gate: All comparison values must be sourced to official listing pages; unverified values stay blank.

suggestions.title: Use official product imagery on product cards
suggestions.problem: Text-only cards feel flat; imagery strongly improves the shop feel.

options.A: Use official Amazon listing imagery (requires compliance confirmation first).
options.B: Clean CSS product cards with badges and price chips, no images (recommended until compliance is confirmed).
options.C: Generate illustrative graphics (avoid - risks looking AI-generated and misrepresenting products).

suggestions.gate: Compliance review against the Associates IP License before any Amazon imagery is used.

suggestions.title: Choose future topics from measured queries, not instinct
suggestions.problem: Topic selection by instinct produces speculative content with no demand signal.

options.A: Weekly query review in Search Console + click counter, pick one topic per review.

suggestions.gate: Requires SG-08 (Search Console) and SG-12 (analytics) to be live first.

suggestions.title: Add privacy-preserving reader capture (newsletter)
suggestions.problem: No way to bring readers back; capture must be consent-first.

options.A: Self-hosted mailing list with explicit consent checkbox (recommended).
options.B: Third-party email ESP with double opt-in.

suggestions.gate: Privacy notice must state purpose, storage, and retention; no pre-checked boxes.

suggestions.title: Validate one Special Link per product in the enrolled Associates workflow before scaling
suggestions.problem: Compliance status of the supplied short links is unresolved (FLG-003); blind scaling risks policy violations.

options.A: Validate all five links one by one, record destination + tracking report per link.
options.B: Validate the highest-traffic three first, then the rest (recommended).
options.C: Assume links are fine and scale (not recommended).

suggestions.gate: Requires an enrolled Associates account and access to the tracking reports.

suggestions.title: Register the site in Google Search Console and keep the sitemap auto-regenerated
suggestions.problem: Search engines need one canonical site to index with a live sitemap.

options.A: Register now and wire sitemap.xml into every publish (recommended).
options.B: Register only after first guide publishes.

suggestions.gate: None. Sitemap is already generated by scripts/build_sitemap.py.

suggestions.title: Organize content into seasonal and topical clusters
suggestions.problem: Flat lists of articles feel like a feed; clusters feel like a publication.

options.A: Full cluster taxonomy with seasonal hubs.
options.B: Two launch clusters: air frying; cooking-temperature accuracy (recommended).

suggestions.gate: Depends on SG-02 having published guides to cluster.

suggestions.title: Enforce the product-intent confirmation gate for every new link
suggestions.problem: Intent and observed redirect are different facts; merging them corrupts the record.

options.A: Block publishing any new product link until intended_asin, intended_listing_url, confirmation_date, and intended_source are filled by the owner.

suggestions.gate: None. Mechanically enforced by the intake script and reviewed in the compliance gate.

suggestions.title: Keep one navigation group and route all dashboard surfaces through the footer
suggestions.problem: Mixing shop pages and dashboards in one nav creates an audit feel.

options.A: Single nav group for shop pages; footer lists dashboard surfaces (already implemented - keep).
options.B: Two nav groups (Shop / Dashboard) (not recommended per brief).

suggestions.title: Deploy the self-hosted analytics endpoint and run a weekly measurement review
suggestions.problem: Clicks and conversions must be measured before any optimization is attempted (measure before automating).

options.A: Deploy server/analytics_server.py on the owner's host, point the site at it (recommended).
options.B: Keep the counter in no-op/demo mode until hosting is decided.
options.C: Use a third-party analytics SaaS (requires privacy review).

suggestions.gate: Privacy notice + retention decision required before real data flows.
